title: A state spent a year asking to be renamed. Parliament finally said yes on this day.

sources.text: DTNext - Tamil Nadu got its name 50 yrs ago this day

caption:
A state spent a year asking to be renamed. Parliament finally said yes on this day.

The change began with the state assembly's unanimous resolution in July 1967. Parliament's debate and passage of the bill in November 1968 cleared the way for the new name to formally take effect in January 1969.

The renaming reflected a broader wave of linguistic-identity state naming in post-independence India, aligning the state's official name with its language and culture rather than its colonial administrative history.

Tamil Nadu's renaming is one small, specific example of a democracy processing identity through its own institutions instead of outside them.
